entries.name: Youngster
entries.motto: I'm gonna be the strongest ever.

entries.name: Schoolkid
entries.motto: I read about this in class.

entries.name: Preschooler
entries.motto: Look, look, my Pokémon is strong!

entries.name: Bug Catcher
entries.motto: Bugs are the best, you'll see.

entries.name: Hiker
entries.motto: One step at a time. That's all.

entries.name: Camper
entries.motto: Fresh air's good for battle too.

entries.name: Ranger
acts: walking the same route for years
entries.motto: The wild is not a toy.

entries.name: Gardener
acts: tending the same beds each morning

entries.name: Beekeeper
entries.motto: Move slowly and nobody gets hurt.

entries.name: Shepherd
entries.motto: I mind my flock. You mind your step.

entries.name: Rancher
entries.motto: Out here, you earn your keep.

entries.name: Duelist
entries.motto: I fight cleanly. I lose cleanly.

entries.name: Gladiator
entries.motto: The crowd demands blood. I give them spectacle.

entries.name: Swimmer
entries.motto: Last one in is a Magikarp!

entries.name: Sailor
entries.motto: The sea doesn't scare me. You might.

entries.name: Captain
entries.motto: A steady hand wins the storm.

entries.name: Pirate
entries.motto: What's yours is mine after this.

entries.name: Diver
entries.motto: It's quiet down there. I like quiet.

entries.name: Lighthouse Keeper
entries.motto: Someone has to keep the light.

entries.name: Professor's Aide
entries.motto: I'm only here to help the research.

entries.name: Researcher
entries.motto: Please don't mess with my data.

entries.name: Archaeologist
entries.motto: The past is not finished with us.

entries.name: Historian
entries.motto: You cannot beat what you do not know.

entries.name: Collector
entries.motto: Every collection starts with an obsession.

entries.name: Trader
entries.motto: Everything has a price. Even this match.

entries.name: Hex Maniac
entries.motto: Don't look at the shadows too long.

entries.name: Fortune Teller
acts: pulling a card for each guest
entries.motto: The cards say you lose. Or win.

entries.name: Monk
entries.motto: Be still, and the path appears.

entries.name: Priestess
entries.motto: May the old spirits watch over you.

entries.name: Shaman
entries.motto: The land speaks. Do you listen?

entries.name: Dreamer
entries.motto: I saw this in a dream, you know.

entries.name: Dancer
entries.motto: Move with me. Or lose with me.

entries.name: Clown
entries.motto: Why so serious? It's just a battle!

entries.name: Magician
entries.motto: Pick a card. Any card. Now battle.

entries.name: Painter
entries.motto: Battles are paintings. Mine will be a masterpiece.

entries.name: Inventor
entries.motto: It might explode. It might not.

entries.name: Tailor
entries.motto: A good fit makes all the difference.

entries.name: Jeweler
entries.motto: The finest things are cut with care.

entries.name: Perfumer
entries.motto: A scent can win a heart. Or a battle.

entries.name: Chef
entries.motto: Everything is about balance. Taste it.

entries.name: Baker
entries.motto: Fresh is better. So are friends.

entries.name: Barista
entries.motto: I'll have your order in a moment.

entries.name: Street Vendor
entries.motto: Come get it while it's hot!

entries.name: Rich Boy
entries.motto: Money can buy anything. Even wins.

entries.name: Lady
entries.motto: I'm sure this will be quite pleasant.

entries.name: Gentleman
entries.motto: Do try to lose with dignity.

entries.name: Businessman
entries.motto: Time is money. Let's end this quickly.

entries.name: Office Worker
entries.motto: I just wanted a quiet lunch break.

entries.name: Detective
entries.motto: Something doesn't add up. Let's find out.

entries.name: Chauffeur
entries.motto: I take pride in my driving.

entries.name: Bellhop
entries.motto: Welcome. May I take your bags?

entries.name: Firefighter
entries.motto: When it burns, I run toward it.

entries.name: Nurse
entries.motto: I'll take good care of them. And you.

entries.name: Vet
entries.motto: Nobody gets hurt on my watch.

entries.name: Trainer's Coach
entries.motto: You're not tired. You're warming up.

entries.name: Burglar
entries.motto: I wasn't here. You never saw me.

entries.name: Hoodlum
entries.motto: Show me what you've got, tough guy.

entries.name: Poacher
entries.motto: Rare ones fetch a good price.

entries.name: Rocket-style Boss
entries.motto: Power belongs to those who take it.

entries.name: Backpacker
entries.motto: The road is the best teacher.

entries.name: Pilgrim
entries.motto: The road is its own prayer.

entries.name: Nomad
entries.motto: Home is wherever the wind is.

entries.name: Explorer
entries.motto: Nobody's been here yet. Except me.

entries.name: Cave Delver
entries.motto: It's cramped. But the stones are lovely.

entries.name: Skater
entries.motto: Wipeouts are part of the style.

entries.name: Runner
entries.motto: The finish line's just up ahead.

entries.name: Racer
entries.motto: Speed's the only thing that matters.

entries.name: Card Shark
entries.motto: I never lose. Not for long.

entries.name: Eccentric
entries.motto: You'll never guess what I did today.

entries.name: Hermit
entries.motto: I don't get many visitors. I like it that way.

entries.name: Mad Hatter
entries.motto: Why is a Pokémon like a writing desk?

entries.name: Conspiracy Theorist
entries.motto: They don't want you to know this.

entries.name: Meteorologist
entries.motto: Rain is coming. I'm rarely wrong.

entries.name: Marine Biologist
entries.motto: The sea is full of surprises.

entries.name: Linguist
entries.motto: Words survive when nothing else does.

entries.name: Philosopher
entries.motto: Why do we fight? Why do we win?

entries.name: Gym Trainer
entries.motto: Beat me and you might meet the leader.

entries.name: Grass Specialist
entries.motto: Roots run deeper than you think.

entries.name: Flying Specialist
entries.motto: Look up. We're in the clouds!

entries.name: Poison Specialist
entries.motto: A little poison goes a long way.

entries.name: Elite Candidate
entries.motto: The Hall of Fame is mine.

entries.name: Champion's Student
entries.motto: I won't let my mentor down.

entries.name: Title Contender
entries.motto: One more win and it's mine.

entries.name: Retired Champion
entries.motto: I was something once, you know.

entries.name: Tower Tycoon
entries.motto: Every floor is a new test.

entries.name: Arcade Regular
entries.motto: One more round, then I quit.

entries.name: Hairdresser
entries.motto: You look great. Almost as good as me.

entries.name: Clockmaker
entries.motto: Time is precise. So am I.

entries.name: Cartographer
entries.motto: Know the terrain. Own the battle.

entries.name: Bard
entries.motto: I'll sing your defeat. Or your triumph.

entries.name: Storyteller
entries.motto: Every battle is a story. Let's see yours.

entries.name: Ringmaster
entries.motto: Ladies and gentlemen, the main event!

entries.name: Street Performer
entries.motto: Tip generously. I'll battle for tips.

entries.name: Pokémon Fan
entries.motto: My favorite Pokémon is the best!

entries.name: Rival Fan
entries.motto: I'm training to be just like them!

entries.name: Night Shift Worker
entries.motto: Please. It's three in the morning.

entries.name: Tutor
entries.motto: Pay attention. This is on the test.

entries.name: Spy
entries.motto: I'm not here. I'm never here.

entries.name: Mercenary
entries.motto: Pay me, and I fight for you.

entries.name: Samurai
entries.motto: A single strike. A single truth.

entries.name: Ninja
entries.motto: You never saw me. I was never here.

entries.name: Oni Mask Wearer
entries.motto: Fear the mask, not the man.
